purpose: Provide a notification service that composes and records order-related messages (receipts and low-stock alerts) and a helper to format currency amounts used in receipts.
components: NotificationService: service class that composes receipt and low-stock alert messages and accumulates them in an in-memory sent_messages list; delegates total formatting to format_currency.
format_currency(cents) -> str: utility function formatting non-negative cent amounts into dollar strings; raises ValueError for negative input.
internal_structure: The module exposes a service class and a small utility. NotificationService composes messages for downstream consumers and records them in an instance-level accumulator. When building receipts, it calls the module-level format_currency helper. The file maintains no module-level state and relies on callers (e.g., OrderService, CLI) to invoke the service.
module_mechanism: At import, the module defines a service class and a formatter function. At runtime, external modules construct NotificationService and invoke its methods; send_receipt uses format_currency to build totals and appends composed messages to the instance accumulator. No external I/O is performed by this module.
outputs: send_receipt: receipt message string recorded in self.sent_messages
send_low_stock_alert: list of low-stock alert strings recorded in self.sent_messages
NotificationService: maintains an in-memory accumulator of composed messages (sent_messages)
side_effects: Appends composed messages to NotificationService.sent_messages (in-memory state)
Maintains an in-memory log of composed messages across calls via NotificationService.sent_messages
